topic: Point Nemo: the ocean spot where astronauts can be closer than anyone on land

facts.claim: Point Nemo is about 1,670 miles away from the nearest land in any direction.
The International Space Station orbits at roughly 250 miles above Earth.
Astronauts on the space station are over 6 times closer to Point Nemo than anyone on dry land.
Space agencies have deorbited more than 263 spacecraft into the Point Nemo region.

meta.title: The Ocean Spot Where Astronauts Are Your Closest Neighbors
